### Props

| Name               | Type                                                                                                                                | Required | Default                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rowActions`       | `Array<{id: string, label: string, icon?: string, type?: string, target?: string, props?: object, handler?: string, args?: Array}>` |          | `[]`                                                         | The host's own actions on each file row, declared the way a manifest declares any action (`open-modal`, `handler`, ...), and dispatched through the page's action runner with the node's `fileId`, `fileName` and `path` merged into an `open-modal` action's props (or appended as the node to a `handler` action's args). Folders get none. `icon` is an MDI icon name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `newActions`       | `Array<{id: string, label: string, icon?: string, type?: string, target?: string, props?: object, handler?: string, args?: Array}>` |          | `[]`                                                         | The host's own entries in the New menu, after the ones the Files app and its plugins register. Each is dispatched like a row action (`type: 'open-modal' \| 'handler' \| …`) through the page's `cnDispatchAction`, carrying the current folder rather than a row, so a host can offer "new from template" or "request a file from a party" here.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `linkedItems`      | `union`                                                                                                                             |          | `[]`                                                         | Rows that are not nodes of this folder: files the host joined from another object's folder. Rendered after the folder's own rows with open and download only. `note` (and its optional `noteHref`) says where the file lives.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `openLinkedLabel`  | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Open')`                        | Label of a linked row's open action.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `downloadLabel`    | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Download')`                    | Label of a linked row's download action.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `rootPath`         | `string`                                                                                                                            | ✓        | —                                                            | The folder this browser is rooted at, relative to the current user's files root (`/Open Registers/Cases/&lt;uuid&gt;`). The browser never navigates above it. Resolve it with `resolveObjectFolder()` for an OpenRegister object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `rootLabel`        | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `null`                                                       | What the root crumb reads. Null shows the folder's own name, which is what the Files app shows; pass a label when the folder on disk is a uuid and the host knows a better name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

| `uploadLabel`      | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Upload files')`                | Label of the upload entry in the New menu.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `newFolderLabel`   | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'New folder')`                  | Label of the new-folder entry and its dialog.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `renameLabel`      | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Rename')`                      | Label of the rename action and its dialog.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

| `emptyLabel`       | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'This folder is empty')`        | Title of the empty state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `emptyHint`        | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Drop files here, or use New')` | Line under the empty state's title.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `retryLabel`       | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Try again')`                   | Label of the retry button on a failed listing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `columns`          | `union`                                                                                                                             |          | `[]`                                                         | The columns this browser shows, in order. An entry is a built-in name (`name`, `size`, `modified`, `owner`, `type`, `tags`) or an object declaring its own: `{ key, label, source, attribute, formatter, sortable }`, where `source` is `node` (a property of the node), `attribute` (a DAV property, added to the PROPFIND before listing) or `row` (a value from `rowData`). Declaring none keeps today's table: name, size and modified. This is the membership list. The Columns chooser lets a user hide any of these; it never adds one, and a column removed from here is gone for every user, whatever they had stored. |
| `rowData`          | `union`                                                                                                                             |          | `null`                                                       | The host's own per-file data for `source: 'row'` columns, keyed by file id. Either an object, or a function of the listed nodes called once per folder so the host can fetch its projection in one request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `preferenceApp`    | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `''`                                                         | The app id the Columns chooser stores this user's choice under. Unset means the chooser is not offered and every declared column renders.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `preferenceKey`    | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `'files-browser-columns'`                                    | The key this browser's column choice is stored under, so two browsers in one app remember separately.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `columnsLabel`     | `string`                                                                                                                            |          | `() =&gt; t('nextcloud-vue', 'Columns')`                     | Label of the toolbar's Columns chooser.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
